title: Retirement
text: Sixty-five. The farewell drinks had a slideshow, a speech and a cake shaped like your first laptop. Now every day of the week is a Saturday. What does a free week look like?

variants.text: Sixty-five. You stopped working a while ago, but now it's official: a pension letter, a cake from the neighbours and every day of the week a Saturday. What does a free week look like?

hints: Callback to the Year 1 phone habit and the asso if relevant.

choices.label: Always connected
choices.hint: Smart home, AI companion, lots of screens

effects.text: Your fridge orders the milk. Your AI companion laughs at all your jokes. Your family calls a little less.
Tuesday is the food bank, Thursday the chess club, Sunday a video call with everyone you love.

footprint.label: Three long-haul trips a year in retirement (10 years)

effects.text: Kyoto, Lima, Cape Town, repeat. Your suitcase has more stamps than your passport.
Two days a week you're the wise elder of the office. The coffee is still bad.

title: Your Legacy
text: Seventy-five. The notary has very soft chairs and very hard questions. What's left of your money, your name and your stubbornness has to go somewhere. Where?

ai.tone: warm, reflective, the last big choice
hints: Mention two or three of the life's biggest choices before asking.
If flag family_kids, the grandchildren are in the waiting room.

effects.text: Your family will inherit your savings, your books and your terrible puns, in that order of value.

choices.label: Fund climate & health research
choices.hint: A foundation with your name on it

effects.text: The {name} Fund for Frugal AI and Climate Health opens its first call for projects. Forty teams apply.
A new lab bears your name. Its first model writes you a lovely thank-you note, then asks for more compute.
Every Wednesday you tutor kids in maths. One of them says you're 'lowkey cool'. You frame it.
